values.note: Hillsdale County Fair camping page (site footer 2026): 30-amp hookup $30 a night, 50-amp $40, $5 more on a site with sewer ('septic'). One rate for everyone (no resident/non-resident split). Fees are owed for each night a site is reserved or a unit sits on it. Dump station $10 for non-campers.

fees.source: https://www.hillsdalecountyfair.org/camping ('The cost of camping is $30.00 30 amp hookup per night $40.00 50 amp hookup per night Add $5 if using a hook up with septic'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.hillsdalecountyfair.org/camping ('All sites have electricity and water hookups (some sewer hook-ups are available'; '50 amp hookup per night'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.hillsdalecountyfair.org/camping ('a sanitary dump station is on site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: April to October, excluding fair week (subject to change). During fair week camping is limited to vendors, open-class and 4-H exhibitors.

season.source: https://www.hillsdalecountyfair.org/camping ('Excluding fair week, the park is open from April to October (subject to change)') + https://www.hillsdalecountyfair.org/faq ('Camping space during fair week is limited to vendors, open class and 4-H exhibitors'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Call the fair office, (517) 437-3622, Monday-Friday 8 am - 4 pm. After hours or on weekends, pay at the drop box at the fair office. A responsible adult (21+) must stay with each site every night.

booking.source: https://www.hillsdalecountyfair.org/camping ('Camping fees will be paid for each night the campsite is reserved'; 'please call (517) 437-3622 during business hours'; 'If you arrive after hours or on the weekend, please place your payment in the drop box located at the fair office'), read 2026-10-22

note: Shaded campground at the Hillsdale County Fairgrounds, open for general overnight camping through the season except fair week; licensed campground groups welcome. --Claude
summary: Fair's camping page (2026 site) confirms $30 30-amp / $40 50-amp (+$5 with sewer), water and electric at every site with some sewer, dump station, open April-October excluding fair week, reserved by phone with an after-hours drop box; phone (517) 437-3622 matches. Event check passes: ordinary public nightly camping all season; the campground closes to the public during fair week (vendors/exhibitors only). Owner is the Hillsdale County Agricultural Society (non-profit), not the county - flagged. Added season note and booking note; note cleaned of the season, hookups, price and booking text the fields hold.
flags: Ownership class: the fairgrounds are 'owned and operated by the Hillsdale County Agricultural Society (a 501 (C) 3 Non-Profit Organization)' (https://www.hillsdalecountyfair.org/about-us), not by Hillsdale County; by the fair-association rule the entry should be `private`, not `local`. As a private park it passes presence (own website with phone) and price ($30 posted, under US$50).

Fair-week check (passes): general camping is open April-October 'Excluding fair week'; during fair week camping is limited to vendors, open-class and 4-H exhibitors (https://www.hillsdalecountyfair.org/faq), so the campground closes to the public for the fair but sells ordinary nightly camping the rest of the season.
